name: RACV Cape Schanck Resort
address: Cape Schanck Rd, Cape Schanck VIC 3939
signature: A full-service coastal resort near the Peninsula's wildest headland — golf, One Spa, dining and accommodation in one self-contained property
editorNote:
RACV Cape Schanck Resort sits on a ridge above Bass Strait near the tip of the ocean coast — a full-service property with an 18-hole golf course, the excellent One Spa, multiple dining options, and accommodation ranging from hotel rooms to villas. It is the Peninsula's most complete resort outside of Jackalope.

The golf course is links-style and wind-exposed, which makes it either thrilling or humbling depending on the conditions. The spa is among the best on the Peninsula. The resort's position — close to Cape Schanck lighthouse and Gunnamatta Beach — makes it a strong base for an ocean-coast Peninsula weekend.

Good for couples who want spa and golf in the same property. Non-RACV members can book directly at a slight premium.
whyWeGo: The Peninsula's most complete ocean-side resort — spa, golf, and the wild coastline on the doorstep.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book One Spa. The treatments are the reason to stay.
